newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Seal to buy, develop land in Selangor.
newsitem.headline: Seal to buy, develop land in Selangor.

text.p: Malaysian timber products firm Seal Inc Bhd said on Thursday it plans to buy a piece of land in central Selangor state which will be developed into a mixed development project.
The company said in a statement that the 33-acre land will be acquired for 68.5 million ringgit. The acquisition will be funded by cash and bank borrowings.
Seal plans to build houses, condominiums and office buildings on the plot of land, with expected revenue from sale of all the units at 400 million ringgit.
Expected pretax profit from the proposed development is 127 million ringgit.
It said the proposed acquisition and development will help the company diversify its earnings from timber to property development.
The company asked the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange to requote its stock following the announcement.
The stock was last traded on June 12 at 4.88 ringgit.
